title: Unit Event — Desperate Times?! Island Panic! — Episode8 With The Best Teamwork Ever!

meta.Episode: Episode8 — With The Best Teamwork Ever!
meta.Event Outline: After a very successful performance at the music hall, Wonderlands×Showtime gets to take a cruiser to their next ambassadorial show venue. But what are they going to do when they all wake up on a desert island after running into a storm...?!

rows.Line: The next day
Coast
se_event_island_2022_009

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Hm...?
Is it morning already...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Mhm... Nene...
You shouldn't eat that gingerbread house... The witch covered it in hot mustard...

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Geez, Emu.
What kind of dream are you...?
se_event_island_2022_009

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Sally sells seashells by the seashore!!!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Huh?!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: So loud...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
120 dB.
About the same as the rotor on a helicopter.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: That's quite a lot of energy this early in the day.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Hm? Ah, pardon me. Did I wake you all?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We won't make our show now, but Shosuke did say that he'd make amends somehow, right...?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Which is why I thought we should be ready to perform at any given time.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tsukasa...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: In that case, I'd like to join you.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Me too...
You don't get many chances to practice in a place like this.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Alright, let's do a run together!
Starting from... The climax!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Wait, starting with the climax?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Yeah, because I really love that scene!
Anyway, here we go!

rows.Speaker: Knight A
rows.Line:
“Princess!
What are we to do? Their army's already come this close...!”

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
*Sigh*
Alright, I'll play along...

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “So they have... How are our forces doing?”

rows.Speaker: Knight B
rows.Line:
“Wounded and fatigued.
At this rate, we'll be...”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line:
“Th-This is rather unsettling...
Not only are people getting hurt, but lives may also be lost along with this country's future...”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “But we cannot run forever...”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “We must make a stand...!”

rows.Speaker: Princess
rows.Line: “My warriors! Now is the time to take up arms!”

rows.Speaker: Knight C
rows.Line:
“Let's do this...!
One last battle to end it all!”

rows.Speaker: Knight A
rows.Line: “Yes, sir!”

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Wow... That was so amazing!
It's like we were in an acting zone just now!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Yes, our tempo and delivery came together perfectly. I'm not sure we've ever synced up so well before.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: What if it's because of our little adventure?! Did having to find a way to survive make us a more cohesive unit?!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
I think so!
Especially since we did so much stuff together!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
And Nene's acting!
That might've been the best she's ever done during one of our practices!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
Yes, especially the last part.
You could sense the terror her character was feeling as she delivered that line.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Now that you mention it, I did have an easier time getting into character. Why do you think that is...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: I have to think it's because of our survival adventure.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Our survival adventure...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (I-Isn't there any other way...?!)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (They sorta have a point. The tension in the air before the curtains go up, being scared of forgetting my lines or worrying about staying in pitch during a song...)

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: (Compared to all that, this is...!)

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: <It won't be easy, but doing your best by working together as a team to get through this will do wonders for you in the future.>

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Now I understand...
This is what MEIKO meant by what she said.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Oh, about our experience paying dividends in the future? Yes, everything she said was correct.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: We'll need to thank her for encouraging us like that!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we can't right now because your phone's battery ran out... I feel like we should take back something as a souvenir...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Oh, what about the bananas pickled in seawater that Rui talked about yesterday?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, you can't really have that anywhere else... But that seems more like a punishment than a gift...

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Although, it could be tastier than we expect.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: And we ate almost all the food we gathered yesterday...

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
50 dB...
About the same as a home air conditioner.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?
Isn't that pretty low for Tsukasa's voice?

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Don't make it sound like I'm shouting at the top of my lungs 24/7!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: No, I don't think she was picking up Tsukasa's voice...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Wah?! Wh-What's that noise?!

rows.Speaker: Robo-Nene
rows.Line:
120 dB.
About the same as the rotor on a helicopter.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: The same as the rotor on a...?

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: It's the sound of a real helicopter.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Ah, it's here.
Sooner than expected too.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Huh?! Shosuke?!
Where were you all this time?!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: I managed to fix the radio around dawn, managed to send out an SOS signal and have been waving around a flag along the coast so that someone might see us.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We can finally leave this place.

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: Excellent!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Thank goodness...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: But we all enjoyed our little desert island adventure, right? It might be nice to do this again someday!

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: We don't have time for that right now. You and your troupe have a show to do.

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line:
What?
Does that mean...?

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: Not today, but I managed to rework your schedule.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: You'll be performing tomorrow due to another party canceling due to the same storm we encountered.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: They were kind enough to let us take that slot.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Tomorrow...?

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
What do you mean? Tomorrow?
So... Today?! What time?!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Calm down!
Tomorrow as in tomorrow! The next day! Not today!

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: I sort of expected it to get postponed, but I didn't think we'd be performing so soon...

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line:
Right.
You haven't had much sleep and are still probably very tired, so you're hardly in the best condition to perform.

rows.Speaker: Shosuke
rows.Line: With that in mind, can you still do this...?

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yes.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line:
Because we're Wonderlands×Showtime.
Anything is possible when it comes to us.

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line: Right, let's practice while we're on the helicopter!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line:
Agreed!
Let's shift gears and get ready to make everyone smile!

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Oh, also!
Let's do our usual cheer!
The one that helps us put smiles on everyone's faces!

rows.Speaker: Tsukasa
rows.Line: W-Wait, here?!

rows.Speaker: Rui
rows.Line: Like we did before we went on the cruiser.

rows.Speaker: Nene
rows.Line: Yeah, if it'll help us get prepared mentally...

rows.Speaker: Emu
rows.Line:
Hehe. Alright, here we go!
Our show's gonna make everyone smile from ear to ear! Ready...?

rows.Speaker: Everyone
rows.Line: Wonderhoy!
